title: Oak of Gernika vs Sineaters of Damascus
lede:
Sineaters of Damascus won 34-20 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6, past the 30 VP target, with 23 VP from objectives to the Oak of Gernika's 15.

The Sineaters' melee charged the Etxe Riflemen off the centre in Battle Round 2 and held it from then to the end (15 VP), and the Beast of Contagion killed the Mikelete Marksmen and the Sorgin on the left flank and held that objective from Round 3 (8 VP).
result_line: Sineaters of Damascus win 34-20 on Victory Points in Battle Round 6
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). Oak of Gernika lined up on row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): the Sugaar Gun at (3,12), Etxe Riflemen 2 with the Foral Captain at (4,12), Etxe Riflemen 1 with Tomas Zumalakarregi at (5,12), the Mikelete Marksmen with the Sorgin at (7,12) and Etxe Riflemen 3 at (10,12), with the Basajaun Smith at (9,13) for the right. Sineaters of Damascus set up on rows 1 and 2 around its HQ at (7,1): Hellkin at (3,1), the Beast of Contagion at (5,2) (it began the battle in the air), Mawkin 2 at (7,2), the Poxknight with The Plague Monarch at (9,2), the Cultist Troopers at (10,2) and Mawkin 1 at (11,2). It was rifle squads and one howitzer against an army of chargers. The Sineaters had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (8 to 10).

1.title: The Oak take the centre and the Mawkin bite back

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Oak, WIDE SWEEP for the Sineaters; secondaries kept, FOCUSED FIRE and KING OF THE HILL. The Plague roll was Glutton's Maw. The Oak spent all 3 CP: Double Time on Etxe Riflemen 3 (2) and Scouting Order on Etxe Riflemen 1 (1), both priced at nothing. The Sineaters spent 2 on Double Time for the Poxknight, also nothing. The Mikelete Marksmen set a Trip Marker on (7,7) and the Basajaun Smith's Burdinola Forge gave Etxe Riflemen 1 +1 AP.

Both armies met on the centre. Etxe Riflemen 3 reached 6,8 and Etxe Riflemen 1 with Tomas Zumalakarregi 6,7; the Poxknight and The Plague Monarch came to 8,7 and the Beast of Contagion to 7,7. Mawkin 2 charged Etxe Riflemen 1 from 7,6. The Basajaun Smith went right to 12,9.

Mawkin 2 struck first (INI 9, +3 for the charge): 18 hits from 31 dice, 13 damage, Etxe Riflemen 1 down from 20 to 7 and six riflemen dead. Tomas and the squad answered for 5 (20 to 15). The Sugaar Gun, +1 HIT against the MARKED Poxknight, hit 3 of 3 for 6 (15 to 9) and left the Poxknight and The Plague Monarch PARALYZED.
The Oak won the centre on OC 17 vs 10, 3 VP, a score that hinged on Etxe Riflemen 3. 3-0.

The Oak spent 2 of 3 CP on Double Time for the Mikelete Marksmen, the Sineaters 2 on Double Time for the Cultist Troopers; both put a move in reach. FOCUSED FIRE expired; new secondaries FORWARD PRESENCE and PROBING STRIKE. The Oak gained 1 Mana from WEATHER-READER.

The Mikelete Marksmen and the Sorgin ran 7,9 to 2,8 onto the left objective, and the Basajaun Smith stepped onto the right at 13,6. The centre emptied of Oak units: Etxe Riflemen 2 walked off to 8,9; the Poxknight charged Etxe Riflemen 1, which failed its Fall Back test (needed 6, rolled 4) and broke away in disorder to 6,10 for 2 True Damage; Mawkin 2 charged Etxe Riflemen 2, Etxe Riflemen 3 and the Foral Captain, and Etxe Riflemen 3 passed its test and fell back to 5,10. Overwatch did 8 in all: Etxe Riflemen 3 hit the Cultist Troopers for 2 and Mawkin 1, whose charge failed, for 6. The Beast of Contagion flew 7,7 to 3,7 and landed its charge on the Sorgin and the Mikelete Marksmen.

The Beast of Contagion's Blades of Necrosis rolled four 6s: 6 damage, Mikelete Marksmen destroyed, and 2 onto the Sorgin (4 to 2). Mawkin 2 put 7 into Etxe Riflemen 2 (20 to 13) and took 2 back. The Sugaar Gun hit the Cultist Troopers for 4 (18 to 14) and PARALYZED them. The Plague Monarch used Benediction of Beelzebub on Etxe Riflemen 2, putting Glutton's Maw on the squad and the Foral Captain.
The Sineaters took the centre on OC 17 vs 0, 3 VP. The Oak scored both flanks: the Sorgin on the left (OC 1 vs 0) and the Basajaun Smith on the right (OC 2 vs 0), 4 VP. 7-3.

The Oak held 4 CP and spent 2 on Rally Cry for Etxe Riflemen 1, which passed its Morale Test. The Sineaters spent none of their 2. PROBING STRIKE expired for the Sineaters; DEEP REACH and STRONGPOINT kept.

Hellkin charged Etxe Riflemen 2 and the Foral Captain at 8,8; the Poxknight and The Plague Monarch charged Etxe Riflemen 3 at 5,8; the Cultist Troopers walked onto the centre at 6,7. Mawkin 2 failed its own Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to 5,5. The Basajaun Smith moved 13,6 to 12,7. Glutton's Maw, from the Round 2 Benediction, took 2 HP off Etxe Riflemen 2 at the end of the phase.

The Poxknight hit Etxe Riflemen 3 for 8 (20 to 12) and left it POISONED. Hellkin put 3 into Etxe Riflemen 2 (11 to 8) and lost 4 HP to the counterattacks (20 to 16). The Sugaar Gun hit the Cultist Troopers for 6 more (14 to 8). The Sorgin channelled Mana (3 in the pool) and the Beast of Contagion then killed it, 10 hits on a 2 HP model, and Took Ground to 2,8. Poison took 3 more off Etxe Riflemen 3 (9 HP).

The Sineaters held the centre (OC 8 vs 0) and the left (OC 2 vs 0), 5 VP; the Oak kept the right, 2. DEEP REACH paid the Oak 3 for the right objective; STRONGPOINT paid the Sineaters 1 VP and 1 CP. 12-9.

4.title: Every charge breaks a squad away

feed.text: The Plague changed to Torpid Stupor. The Oak spent all 5 CP on Troop Requisition: a new Etxe Riflemen at 8,12 with 0 APt this round. The Sineaters bought Rally Cry for the Cultist Troopers (2 CP) and later Go to Ground for the Poxknight (1 CP). KING OF THE HILL expired unscored for the Sineaters; SECURE THE FLANKS and DEEP REACH kept.

The Cultist Troopers charged Etxe Riflemen 3, which failed its Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to 7,11; the Poxknight charged Etxe Riflemen 2, which failed too and broke away to 9,10. Mawkin 1 charged the new Etxe Riflemen at 9,12 and took 2 from Etxe Riflemen 2's Overwatch. Hellkin stood on the centre at 8,7 and the Beast of Contagion on the left at 1,8.

Go to Ground gave the Sugaar Gun -1 HIT; it hit 2 of 2 anyway for 6 (9 to 3) and PARALYZED the Poxknight and The Plague Monarch again. Mawkin 1 put 4 into the new Etxe Riflemen (20 to 16), which had no APt to counterattack. Benediction of Beelzebub on Etxe Riflemen 3 changed nothing: the squad was already AFFLICTED. Poison took Etxe Riflemen 3 to 5 HP.
Centre (OC 14 vs 0) and left to the Sineaters, 5 VP; the right to the Oak, 2. DEEP REACH paid the Sineaters 3 for the left. 14-17.

The Sineaters spent 3 of 4 CP on Troop Requisition: a second Cultist Troopers at 7,2. The Oak spent 2 of 3 on Double Time for Etxe Riflemen 1, which bought nothing. Etxe Riflemen 1 and 2 failed Morale on natural 1s and were SUPPRESSED, as were the Poxknight and the Cultist Troopers. New secondaries: KING OF THE HILL and FORWARD PRESENCE.

Mawkin 1 passed its Fall Back test and left the new Etxe Riflemen for 12,11. Mawkin 2 charged Etxe Riflemen 1 and Tomas Zumalakarregi at 9,7. The Poxknight moved to 8,8 and the Cultist Troopers to 7,8, both on the centre.

Mawkin 2 rolled three criticals for 3 extra dice and 8 hits: Etxe Riflemen 1 destroyed (5 to 0) and 2 on Tomas (7 to 5). Tomas hit back with all 5 dice for 5 (14 to 9). Four Oak units then shot Mawkin 1 in the forest at 12,11 for 4 in all: the Sugaar Gun and the new Etxe Riflemen missed, Etxe Riflemen 2 hit for 4 (12 to 8).
Centre (OC 4 vs 0) and left to the Sineaters, the right to the Oak. WIDE SWEEP paid the Sineaters 2 for units in three quarters. 16-24.

The Oak spent all 4 CP: Double Time on the new Etxe Riflemen (2) and Rally Cry for Tomas Zumalakarregi (2). The Sineaters spent 2 of 3 on Double Time for Mawkin 2. FORWARD PRESENCE and SECURE THE FLANKS expired for the Oak; IRON CURTAIN and IRON GRIP kept. Mawkin 1 failed Morale and was SUPPRESSED.

Tomas Zumalakarregi left his dead squad and charged Hellkin on the centre at 8,6; Hellkin failed its Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to 5,5 for 3 True Damage. Mawkin 2 passed its Fall Back test and left Tomas for 5,9, and Mawkin 1 came to 10,10, three squares from the Oak's HQ. The new Etxe Riflemen ran 10,9 to 10,5.

The Etxe Riflemen shot the new Cultist Troopers for 8 (20 to 12). The Sugaar Gun finished the Poxknight on the centre, 3 to 0: Poxknight destroyed, the only Sineaters unit lost all battle. Benediction of Beelzebub put Torpid Stupor on Tomas. With Mawkin 1 standing three squares from the Oak's HQ at the end of the Action Phase, FORWARD PRESENCE paid the Sineaters 3 VP and 1 CP.

The Plague Monarch held the centre alone against Tomas, OC 4 vs 3, 3 VP; the left went to the Sineaters and the right to the Oak. ERADICATE THE FOE paid the Oak 2 for the Poxknight; WIDE SWEEP paid the Sineaters 2. 20-34, the Sineaters past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

Sineaters of Damascus took 23 of their 34 VP from objectives: the centre from Round 2 to 6 (15) and the left from Round 3 to 6 (8). The other 11 came from secondaries (STRONGPOINT 1, DEEP REACH 3, FORWARD PRESENCE 3) and WIDE SWEEP (2 in each of the last two rounds). Oak of Gernika scored 15 objective VP: the centre once in Round 1, the left once through the Sorgin in Round 2 and the right in all five rounds from Round 2. It added DEEP REACH (3) and ERADICATE THE FOE (2, in Round 6 only). Its Primary asks for kills in Objective Areas, and the Oak destroyed one enemy unit in six rounds.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

For the Sineaters, Mawkin 2 was the best unit on the table: 27 damage for 28 RP: its charges took Etxe Riflemen 1 from 20 to 7 in Round 1, pushed Etxe Riflemen 3 off the centre in Round 2 and destroyed Etxe Riflemen 1 in Round 5. The Beast of Contagion scored 9.4 VP (8 objective VP hinged on it) and made both kills on the left, the Mikelete Marksmen and the Sorgin. Hellkin (5.8 VP) and The Plague Monarch (4.8 VP, the last 3 alone at OC 4 vs 3) kept the centre. The Cultist Troopers made no action in six rounds, PARALYZED by the Sugaar Gun or SUPPRESSED for much of it, but scored 3.9 VP just by standing on the centre, 38.5 per 100 RP.

For the Oak, the Basajaun Smith held the right from Round 2 to the end: 11.5 VP, all 10 objective VP hinged on it. It made no action all battle (inaction 6) and needed none. The Sugaar Gun hit something in five of its six attacks, 25 damage, PARALYZED the Poxknight pair twice and the Cultist Troopers twice, and made the Oak's one kill. The four Etxe Riflemen squads did 28 damage between them in six rounds. Four times in Rounds 2 and 4 a charged Etxe squad fell back, and three of those broke away in disorder after failing the Fall Back test.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Oak could not do

Hold the centre against charges. In Round 2 every Oak unit on the centre left it: Etxe Riflemen 2 by its own move, Etxe Riflemen 1 by a failed Fall Back test, Etxe Riflemen 3 by a Fall Back the record calls doubtful (9.33 expected melee damage against 20 HP). The Sineaters scored it on OC 17 vs 0, so Etxe Riflemen 3 staying would probably not have kept it that round. After that its three original squads were worn down to 5 or 6 HP each and never stood on the centre again; Tomas's charge in Round 6 came within one OC (4 vs 3). Its secondaries needed reach it did not have: FORWARD PRESENCE (within 3 squares of the enemy HQ) and FOCUSED FIRE (three attackers on one target in an Action Phase) never came close.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Rounds 4 to 6, Basajaun Smith and SECURE THE FLANKS: the card asks for a unit in the enemy half (rows 0 to 6) within 2 squares of a side edge. The Basajaun Smith stood at 12,7 on the centre row for all three rounds; at 13,6, where it held the same objective in Round 2, it would have completed the card for 2 VP and 1 CP.
  • Round 2, the centre given up: see above. Etxe Riflemen 2's move to 8,9 is one of the three moves the digest marks as undone.
  • Rounds 3 and 4, Benediction of Beelzebub on Etxe Riflemen 3: both uses changed nothing, because the squad was already AFFLICTED.
  • Mana: the Oak gathered 3 Mana and spent none; its only caster, the Sorgin, channelled in Round 3 and died that round.
  • Fall Back record: it lists 28 decisions, but only 8 were real Fall Backs. Several of the 20 holds are charge-planning probes with no enemy adjacent: the Sugaar Gun's two risky holds (Rounds 5 and 6) at 3,12, the Basajaun Smith in Rounds 2, 3 and 6, the HQ in Round 6.

Most of this result is the matchup. Melee chargers with the first strike (Mawkin INI 9 +3 on the charge) beat rifle squads whose Fall Back tests kept failing. The Oak's AI made it worse by leaving the centre in Round 2 and missing SECURE THE FLANKS, but 14 VP is more than those two cost.

closing: The Sugaar Gun and the Basajaun Smith did their jobs, but the Oak's riflemen could not stand where the Sineaters' Mawkin, Poxknight and Hellkin could reach them. Every charge pushed a squad off ground it needed, and the Beast of Contagion took the other flank. From Round 3 the Sineaters held two of the three objectives every round and reached 30 first.
